observed.grouping_key: run_id + pair_id (one effective group per pair)

aggregation.independent_unit: run_id (pair_id lineage collapses paired runs into one group)
aggregation.reporting: per independent test run/group and pooled across groups; correlated windows and correlated folds are never counted as independent experiments

aiw.definition: t_critical - t_warning - T_system - T_physical in seconds; T_system is sensing + inference + policy + command overhead
aiw.name: AIW
aiw.undefined_behavior: NOT_ESTIMABLE with the exact missing precondition; never zero

calibration.applicability: only when the frozen output semantics are a calibrated probability; with risk_score semantics calibration metrics are NOT_APPLICABLE and no probability wording is permitted
calibration.fit_population: development data only; never the locked test

false_warning_burden.denominator: trusted eligible run-hours in the locked test

missed_events.denominator: eligible critical events in the locked test

event_metrics.warning_episode_definition: contiguous samples above the frozen operating threshold for at least the frozen persistence rule k; bridging follows the frozen event matching policy only

ewt.definition: t_reactive - t_predictive in seconds (negative kept, never clamped)
ewt.name: EWT
ewt.undefined_behavior: NOT_ESTIMABLE with the exact missing precondition; never zero

invalid_and_censored_data.rule: exclude only per predeclared validity rules; report exclusion counts and run/group denominators; never impute, never zero-fill missingness

primary_metric.definition: Average precision from the precision/recall curve of risk scores against the frozen binary label, with no interpolation.
primary_metric.denominator: all eligible positive and negative anchors; AP averages precision at each positive rank
primary_metric.name: non_interpolated_average_precision
primary_metric.population: eligible trusted locked-test anchors from frozen independent test runs, partitioned exactly as registered
primary_metric.undefined_behavior: report UNDEFINED_SINGLE_CLASS_TEST / UNDEFINED_NO_ELIGIBLE_ANCHORS; never report 0 or 1 for an uncomputable metric
undefined_cases: frozen label unavailable for any test run

precision.definition: tp / (tp + fp) at the frozen operating threshold and persistence rule

recall.definition: tp / positive anchors at the frozen operating threshold and persistence rule

uncertainty_reporting: explicit non-estimable statuses for every undefined metric
limitations section stating the tested prototype/configuration only

synthetic_evidence_statement: All currently registered population, model and split identities are synthetic software controls. They cannot support a physical predictive claim.
